_readme: Home-page hero background rotation. Put image files in /assets/legacy/ and list them in the 'images' array below — the hero picks them up automatically, crossfading every 6 seconds (static for reduced-motion users). While 'images' is empty the hero shows the brand gradient instead. The '_staged' entries match the owner's four collected photos: move each one into 'images' as soon as its file exists in frontend/public/assets/legacy/, or the page would request missing files.
